LanguageData.Gun_Mle_1886_RWP.description: The Mle 1886 M93, a bolt-action rifle renowned for its historical significance, offers formidable stopping power with its long-range capabilities. An enduring symbol of late 19th-century military innovation, this firearm is prized for its accuracy, though it sacrifices firing speed for precision. Ideal for marksmen who prioritize distance and impact over rapid fire.
